$schema-note: Copy to .project-brain/conventions.json and prune to what your project actually enforces. Each rule blocks Edit/Write/MultiEdit at the PreToolUse hook and is also checked by `npm run brain:lint-conventions -- --scan` in pre-commit/CI. Cite the ADR that owns each rule in the message so the agent knows where to read more.

rules.name: no-supabase-from-outside-db-or-actions
rules.message: Raw supabase.from() must live in lib/db/ (reads) or lib/actions/ (writes). RLS is enforced via has_venue_role — see .project-brain/decisions/0001-rls-as-single-authz-source.md.

rules.name: no-service-role-in-app-code
rules.message: Service-role key bypasses RLS. Only scripts/ and supabase/ may reference it. See decisions/0001-rls-as-single-authz-source.md.

rules.name: server-only-in-client-component
rules.message: A 'use client' file cannot import 'server-only'. Move server logic into lib/db/ or lib/actions/ and call it from a server component.

rules.name: no-direct-rls-disable
rules.message: Disabling RLS is forbidden. Use a security-definer RPC for anon flows — see decisions/0003-anon-public-flow-via-security-definer-rpcs.md.

rules.name: no-any-without-justification
rules.message: `: any` requires a `// ok-any: <reason>` trailing comment. TS 5 — see CLAUDE.md stack section.
